rows.label: qst640407_msg0002
rows.name:
I have to do it for everyone, but if I
go into that room, I'll definitely
die...

rows.label: qst640407_msg0003
rows.name:
Then I'll never see Sunya again...
What should I do...?

rows.label: qst640407_msg0006
rows.name:
Never seeing my wife again is fine,
but I can't go on if I might never see
my daughter again...

rows.label: qst640407_msg0007
rows.name:
What...? You didn't come to hear me
complain—you came to help?

rows.label: qst640407_msg0009
rows.name:
There's a material needed for repairs
called a Fuse Valve in the Old Pipe
Maintenance Room ahead.

rows.label: qst640407_msg0010
rows.name:
Amir gave me the unreasonable task of
bringing back three, but that room is
very dangerous.

rows.label: qst640407_msg0011
rows.name: Can I leave it to you...?

rows.label: qst640407_msg0101
rows.name:
There's a material needed for repairs
called a Fuse Valve in the Old Pipe
Maintenance Room ahead.

rows.label: qst640407_msg0102
rows.name:
I need three of them. I'm counting on
you.

rows.label: qst640407_msg0201
rows.name:
These really are Fuse Valves... Thank
you.

rows.label: qst640407_msg0202
rows.name:
I'll take these back to the Geothermal
Mining Plant. I need to get them to
Amir quickly...

rows.label: qst640407_msg0203
rows.name:
Thanks to you, I survived. I'll see my
daughter again... Thank you from the
bottom of my heart.
